labels: A narrow horizontal opening cuts into the jacket front, bordered by slim fabric welts rather than an externally attached pocket panel.; 재킷 앞판의 가는 가로 절개 입구가 좁은 천 띠로 둘러싸이며 겉에 덧댄 주머니판과 구분된다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: A narrow horizontal opening cuts into the jacket front, bordered by slim fabric welts rather than an externally attached pocket panel.
aliases: 웰트 포켓의 절개 입구
